overall: The AG found no Open Meeting Law violation: the 'Legal Fees' topic was sufficiently specific, the unanticipated discussion of the complainant needed no notice, and no individual notice was required for an open-session discussion.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the September 12 notice topic 'Legal Fees' was not sufficiently detailed to advise the public of the discussion.
allegations.key_passage: we find that the topic as listed, "Discussion: Legal Fees," provided the public with sufficient detail about the discussion anticipated by Chair Stone

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board discussed her at the September 12 meeting without it being listed on the notice.
allegations.key_passage: Because Chair Stone did not anticipate this discussion about the complainant, he was not required to list it on the notice and thus did not violate the law by failing to do so.

allegations.summary: Complainant alleged the Board should have given her individual notice that it planned to discuss her at the meeting.
allegations.key_passage: Because the discussion was held in open session, the Board was not required to give the complainant individual notice and therefore did not violate the Open Meeting Law for failing to do so prior to this meeting.
